data.description: Grand Fruit Connect is a colorful and relaxing tile-matching puzzle packed with juicy fruits! Find matching tiles, collect them, and clear the board layer by layer. Plan your moves carefully, avoid filling up the tray, and use helpful boosters when things get tricky. Complete each level and put your matching skills to the test!
